core: 一段(文章); 通道; 经过
meaning: n.一段(文章); 通道; 经过.

exam.en: Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once.
exam.cn: 短文和问题都只播放一遍。

examples.en: My office is just along the passage.
examples.cn: 我的办公室就在过道旁边。

examples.en: We walked down a narrow passage to the back of the building.
examples.cn: 我们沿着一条狭窄的通道来到大楼的后面。

meaning: n. 底部；基础 adj. 卑鄙的

examples.en: India has a good scientific research base.
examples.cn: 印度有良好的科研基础。

core: 部分; 章节; 区域
meaning: n.部分; 章节; 区域.

exam.en: Section C For getting around in Miami.
exam.cn: C部分：在迈阿密出行。

examples.en: The plane’s tail section was found in a cornfield.
examples.cn: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

examples.en: the smoking section (= where you can smoke )
examples.cn: 吸烟区

meaning: n.回答; 答案. v.回答; 答复.

exam.en: The answer is, literally, at your fingertips.
exam.cn: 答案，真的，就在你的指尖。

examples.en: She thought for a moment before answering.
examples.cn: 她想了一会儿才回答。

examples.en: He still hadn’t answered my question .
examples.cn: 他仍然没有回答我的问题。

core: 学习; 研究; 书房
meaning: n.学习; 研究; 书房. v.学习; 研究.

exam.en: He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
exam.cn: 他正和吉米一起做一个研究项目。

examples.en: Recent studies show that women still get paid a lot less than men.
examples.cn: 最近的调查表明,女性的薪水仍比男性的要低很多。

examples.en: The study was carried out between January and May 2008.
examples.cn: 这项研究是在 2008 年1月到5月间进行的。

core: 标记; 分数; 目标
meaning: n.标记; 分数; 目标. v.做记号; 批改; 标志.

examples.en: I can’t get these marks out of my T-shirt.
examples.cn: 我无法把我T恤衫上的这些污迹去掉。

examples.en: I’ve marked the pages you need to look at.
examples.cn: 我把你需要看的几页做了记号。

meaning: n.选择; 选择权. adj.精选的; 上等的.

exam.en: Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter.
exam.cn: 词库中的每个选项都由一个字母标识。

examples.en: He has to make some important choices.
examples.cn: 他得作出一些重要的抉择。

examples.en: They gave us no choice in the matter.
examples.cn: 在这件事情上他们没给我们选择的余地。

core: 部分; 角色; 零件
meaning: n.部分; 角色; 零件. v.分开; 分离.

exam.en: It has become a crucial part of employees' overall work experience.
exam.cn: 它已成为员工整体工作体验的关键部分。

examples.en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
examples.cn: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

examples.en: When he parted the curtains, the sunlight flooded into the room.
examples.cn: 他拉开窗帘,阳光洒进屋内。

meaning: n.信; 字母; 文字.

exam.en: Each paragraph is marked with a letter.
exam.cn: 每个段落都用一个字母标记。

examples.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
examples.cn: 英语字母表有26个字母。

core: 床单; 薄片; 一张纸
meaning: n.床单; 薄片; 一张纸.

exam.en: She covered its screen with a plastic sheet.
exam.cn: 她用一张塑料布盖住了它的屏幕。

examples.en: I’ll go and find you some clean sheets and blankets.
examples.cn: 我去给你们找些干净的床单和毯子。

examples.en: white cotton sheets
examples.cn: 白色的棉布床单

core: 相应的; 对应的; 符合的
meaning: adj.相应的; 对应的; 符合的. v.符合; 通信; 对应(correspond 的现在分词).

examples.en: The war and the corresponding fall in trade have had a devastating effect on the country.
examples.cn: 战争以及由此所导致的贸易量下降对这个国家产生了致命的影响。

meaning: v.选择; 决定.

exam.en: You may choose a paragraph more than once.
exam.cn: 你可以多次选择同一个段落。

examples.en: It took us ages to choose a new carpet.
examples.cn: 我们挑选新地毯花了很长时间。

examples.en: A panel of judges will choose the winner.
examples.cn: 会由一个评判小组选出冠军。

core: 单一的; 单身的; 单程的
meaning: adj.单一的; 单身的; 单程的. n.单人间; 单身者. v.选出.

exam.en: Chetan-Walsh believes in a ban on single-use bottles.
exam.cn: 切坦-沃尔什赞成禁止使用一次性瓶子。

examples.en: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
examples.cn: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

examples.en: They won the game by a single point.
examples.cn: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

core: 线; 行; 行列; 方针
meaning: n.线; 行; 行列; 方针.

exam.en: It suggests that narrow winners become even bigger winners down the line.
exam.cn: 这表明以微弱优势取胜的赢家日后会变成更大的赢家。

examples.en: Draw a straight line across the top of the page.
examples.cn: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

examples.en: Sign your name on the dotted line (= line made up of a series of dots ).
examples.cn: 在虚线上签名。

core: 成为; 变得; 适合
meaning: v.成为; 变得; 适合.

exam.en: She helped the village to become famous.
exam.cn: 她帮助那个村子出了名。

examples.en: The weather became warmer.
examples.cn: 天气变暖和了。

examples.en: Slowly my eyes became accustomed to the darkness.
examples.cn: 我的眼睛渐渐适应了黑暗。

core: 中心; 中央; 中心区
meaning: n.中心; 中央; 中心区.

exam.en: I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today.
exam.cn: 我今天要去市中心买一部新手机。

examples.en: The title isn’t quite centred on the page, is it?
examples.cn: 标题并不在这页的正中间,是吗?

examples.en: lines radiating out from the centre
examples.cn: 从中心向外辐射的线条

core: 银行; 库; 库(如题库或词库); 河岸
meaning: n.银行; 库; 库(如题库或词库); 河岸. v.把(钱)存入银行; 倾斜飞行.

exam.en: Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter.
exam.cn: 题库中的每个选项用一个字母标识。

examples.en: the river bank
examples.cn: 河岸

examples.en: Did you bank that check?
examples.cn: 你把那张支票存入银行了吗?

core: 陈述; 声明; 报表
meaning: n.陈述; 声明; 报表.

exam.en: The statement given below is for your reference.
exam.cn: 以下陈述供你参考。

examples.en: In an official statement, she formally announced her resignation.
examples.cn: 在一份官方声明中,她正式宣布辞职。

core: 认出; 识别; 确定
meaning: v.认出; 识别; 确定.

exam.en: Identify the suspect on the security video.
exam.cn: 从监控录像中辨认出嫌疑人。

examples.en: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
examples.cn: 他离得太远,没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

examples.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
examples.cn: 警方采集了指纹,对尸体作了身份确认。

core: 理解力; 领悟能力; 阅读听力理解练习
meaning: n.理解力; 领悟能力; 阅读听力理解练习.

meanings.cn: 理解, 理解力, 领悟

examples.en: Why you let her talk you into doing such a foolish thing is beyond my comprehension (= impossible for me to understand ) .
examples.cn: 你怎么会被她说服去做这种蠢事,我实在是无法理解。

core: 需要; 要求; 命令
meaning: vt.需要; 要求; 命令.

exam.en: Advise them to choose jobs that require quick reactions.
exam.cn: 建议他们选择需要快速反应的工作。

examples.en: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
examples.cn: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折,可能需要手术。

examples.en: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
examples.cn: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

meaning: adj.最小的; 最少的. adv.最小; 最少. n.最少量.

exam.en: The ability to work with the least supervision.
exam.cn: 在最少的监督下工作的能力。

examples.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.
examples.cn: 我尽可能少得罪人。

examples.en: At least he didn’t lie to me.
examples.cn: 至少他没跟我撒谎。

meaning: adj.接下来的; 下列的. prep.在…之后. v.跟随(follow 的现在分词).

exam.en: It is found that people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task.
exam.cn: 研究发现，人们在完成一项乏味任务之后会更有创造力。

examples.en: The following day the picture appeared on the front pages of every newspaper in the world.
examples.cn: 次日,照片出现在世界各地报纸的头版。

examples.en: We went to dinner the following Monday evening.
examples.cn: 在接下来的那个周一晚上我们一起共进晚餐。

core: 决定; 下决心; 解决
meaning: vt.决定; 下决心; 解决. vi.决定; 判定.

exam.en: They decide to move to cooler mountainous areas.
exam.cn: 他们决定搬到更凉爽的山区。

examples.en: Has anything been decided yet?
examples.cn: 已经作出什么决定了吗?

examples.en: The trainees decide among themselves what programs to take.
examples.cn: 受训者自行选择课程。

meaning: n.空白处; 空格. adj.空白的; 茫然的.

exam.en: You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage.
exam.cn: 你需要从短文后的词库所列选项中为每个空白选择一个单词。

examples.en: Leave the last page blank .
examples.cn: 最后一页留空。

examples.en: a blank cassette
examples.cn: 一盒空白磁带

meaning: n.阅读; 读物. v.读(read的现在分词).

exam.en: But they are generally reading short texts.
exam.cn: 但他们通常是在读短文。

examples.en: She loves reading.
examples.cn: 她喜欢看书。

examples.en: Reading is taught using a combination of several methods.
examples.cn: 综合运用多种方法进行阅读教学。

meaning: n.列表; 清单. v.列出; 把…列入名单.

exam.en: Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised.
exam.cn: 草拟一份将要承诺提高的效率的清单。

examples.en: We are making a list of the top ten men we would not want to be married to.
examples.cn: 我们正在列一个我们最不想嫁的10种男人的名单。

examples.en: The pupils were asked to list the sports they loved most and hated most.
examples.cn: 学生们被要求列出他们最喜欢的和最讨厌的运动。

core: 项目; 一件物品; 条款
meaning: n.项目; 一件物品; 条款.

exam.en: Figuring out the positive properties of each food item.
exam.cn: 弄清楚每种食物的有益特性。

examples.en: He opened the cardboard box and took out each item.
examples.cn: 他打开纸板箱把里面的物品一一拿出来。

examples.en: The store is having a sale on furniture and household items.
examples.cn: 这家商店正在减价出售家具和家居用品。

meaning: v.选择; 挑选. adj.精选的; 优等的.

exam.en: You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage.
exam.cn: 你需要从文章后面的词库中为每个空白选择一个单词。

examples.en: a group of students selected at random
examples.cn: 随机挑选出来的一组学生

examples.en: The party was small and select.
examples.cn: 团里人员不多,都是经过精心挑选的。

meaning: v.需要; 必须. n.需要; 需求.

exam.en: They need extra help to catch up in the math class.
exam.cn: 他们需要额外帮助才能在数学课上跟上来。

examples.en: She works to provide for her family’s basic needs.
examples.cn: 她工作是为了维持家里的基本生计。

examples.en: He needs to see a doctor straightaway.
examples.cn: 他有必要马上去看医生。

meaning: adj.更少的; 较少的. adv.更少地; 较小地(little 的比较级).

exam.en: It is more spacious and less crowded.
exam.cn: 它更宽敞，也没那么拥挤。

examples.en: Maybe he would worry less if he understood the situation.
examples.cn: 他要是了解情况,也许就不会那么担心了。

examples.en: In recent years she has appeared in public less frequently.
examples.cn: 近年来她在公开场合露面的次数少了。

core: 信息; 消息; 资料
meaning: n.信息; 消息; 资料.

exam.en: Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived.
exam.cn: 找出该信息源自哪一段落。

examples.en: I need more information.
examples.cn: 我需要更多信息。

meaning: n.段落; 短文.

exam.en: You may choose a paragraph more than once.
exam.cn: 你可以多次选择同一个段落。

examples.en: the opening paragraphs of the novel
examples.cn: 小说开篇的几个段落

core: 看; 看起来; 寻找
meaning: v.看; 看起来; 寻找. n.看; 外貌.

exam.en: What does my dream company culture look like?
exam.cn: 我梦想的公司文化是什么样的？

examples.en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
examples.cn: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到,偷偷地溜了出去。

examples.en: If you look carefully you can see that the painting represents a human figure.
examples.cn: 如果仔细看,就会看出画上是一个人形。

core: 好处; 益处; 福利
meaning: n.好处; 益处; 福利. v.受益; 对……有益.

exam.en: Who will benefit if working from home becomes the norm?
exam.cn: 如果居家办公成为常态，谁会从中受益？

examples.en: I never had the benefit of a university education.
examples.cn: 我从未受过大学教育。

examples.en: The new credit cards will be of great benefit to our customers.
examples.cn: 新信用卡将大大方便我们的客户。

meaning: v. 包含；控制

examples.en: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
examples.cn: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

examples.en: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

meaning: n. 指导；方向

examples.en: Which direction did they go in ?
examples.cn: 他们朝哪个方向走了?

examples.en: The girls pointed in the opposite direction .
examples.cn: 女孩子们指了相反的方向。

meaning: v. 缚,系,贴；附加

examples.en: We attach labels to things before we file them away.
examples.cn: 我们在把东西归档前先给它们贴上标签。

examples.en: When approving a merger, the commission can attach conditions.
examples.cn: 委员会在批准公司合并时可能附加条件。

meaning: v. 取得；起源

examples.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
examples.cn: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

examples.en: The name Anastasia is derived from a Greek word meaning "of the resurrection."
examples.cn: 阿纳斯塔西娅这个名字是从一个意为“复活”的希腊词语衍生而来的。

core: 报告; 报道; 成绩报告单
meaning: n.报告; 报道; 成绩报告单. v.报告; 汇报; 报道.

exam.en: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
exam.cn: 新闻报道和问题都只播一遍。

examples.en: According to recent news reports , two of the victims are Americans.
examples.cn: 根据近期的新闻报道,受害者中有两名是美国人。

examples.en: This is Gavin Williams, reporting from the United Nations in New York.
examples.cn: 我是加文·威廉斯,在纽约联合国总部为您报道。

meaning: n.研究; 调查. v.做研究; 调查.

exam.en: What does Liebman say about industry-funded research?
exam.cn: 利布曼对行业资助的研究有什么看法？

examples.en: Gould was helped in his researches by local naturalists.
examples.cn: 古尔德在研究过程中得到了当地博物学家的帮助。

meaning: adj.不同的; 有区别的.

exam.en: But work stress can take many different forms.
exam.cn: 但工作压力可以表现为许多不同形式。

examples.en: The place looks completely different now.
examples.cn: 这地方现在完全变了。

examples.en: They decided to try a radically different approach.
examples.cn: 他们决定尝试一种全然不同的办法。

meaning: n.作者; 作家.

exam.en: What does the author say about educators?
exam.cn: 作者对教育工作者说了什么？

examples.en: Nothomb is a Belgian author.
examples.cn: 诺东是位比利时作家。

examples.en: It’s clear that the author is a woman.
examples.cn: 显然,这位作者是女性。

meaning: v.增加; 增长. n.增加; 增长.

exam.en: Encourage employees to increase their visibility on social media.
exam.cn: 鼓励员工增加他们在社交媒体上的曝光度。

examples.en: Recent tax increases have affected the poor more than the rich.
examples.cn: 新近的增税对穷人的影响比对富人的大。

examples.en: the dramatic increase in the population aged over 65
examples.cn: 65岁以上人口的急剧增加

meaning: n.大学; 综合性大学.

exam.en: Directions: Suppose your university student union is planning to hold a speech contest.
exam.cn: 说明：假设你们大学的学生会正计划举办一场演讲比赛。

core: 转动; 翻转; 变成
meaning: v.转动; 翻转; 变成. n.轮到; 转弯.

examples.en: Ricky turned and walked away.
examples.cn: 里基转身走了。

examples.en: She turned her head in surprise.
examples.cn: 她惊讶地转过头来。

core: 末尾; 尽头; 结束
meaning: n.末尾; 尽头; 结束. v.结束; 终止.

exam.en: At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions.
exam.cn: 在每段对话结束时，你会听到四个问题。

examples.en: At last it seemed the war might be coming to an end.
examples.cn: 终于战争似乎即将结束。

examples.en: The spacecraft is nearing the end of its useful life.
examples.cn: 该航天器的使用寿命快要终结。

meaning: adj.重要的; 重大的.

exam.en: Exercise is more important to good health than diet.
exam.cn: 运动对健康比饮食更重要。

examples.en: a very important meeting
examples.cn: 很重要的会议

examples.en: The accident taught him an important lesson.
examples.cn: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

meaning: v.导致; 引起. n.原因; 事业.

exam.en: It may cause a shortage of doctors.
exam.cn: 这可能会导致医生短缺。

examples.en: It’s our job to establish the cause of the fire.
examples.cn: 查明起火原因是我们的责任。

core: 一致,符合；谅解,协议；使一致
meaning: n. 一致,符合；谅解,协议 v. 使一致

examples.en: The punishments accorded with the current code of discipline.
examples.cn: 处罚与现行的纪律规则一致。

examples.en: You will not be accorded any special treatment.
examples.cn: 你不会得到任何特殊待遇。

meaning: n.结果; 成果. v.导致; 起因于.

exam.en: It may result in a crowded beach.
exam.cn: 这可能会导致海滩拥挤。

examples.en: High unemployment is a direct result of the recession.
examples.cn: 高失业率是经济衰退的直接后果。

examples.en: Growing plants from seed can produce disappointing results .
examples.cn: 将种子培育成植株,有时会产生令人失望的结果。

meaning: adj.最近的; 近来的.

exam.en: The number of ducks has declined sharply in recent years.
exam.cn: 近年来，鸭子的数量急剧下降。

examples.en: Irving’s most recent book
examples.cn: 欧文最新的书

examples.en: recent research into the causes of cancer
examples.cn: 近来对致癌原因的研究

meaning: v.开始; 启动. n.开始; 起点.

exam.en: That's still a good place to start.
exam.cn: 那仍然是一个好的起点。

examples.en: There’s so much to do. I don’t know where to start.
examples.cn: 有那么多的事情要做,我都不知道从哪里开始。

examples.en: Have you started your homework?
examples.cn: 你开始做家庭作业了吗?

meaning: adv.然而；不管怎样. conj.不管用什么方法.

exam.en: However, these savings result from passing costs on to workers.
exam.cn: 然而，这些节省是通过将成本转嫁给工人来实现的。

examples.en: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
examples.cn: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法,不过有危险。

examples.en: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
examples.cn: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

meaning: adv.实际上；事实上.

exam.en: They were actually native to North America.
exam.cn: 它们实际上原产于北美。

examples.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
examples.cn: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了,实际上我们从小就认识。

examples.en: Actually, on second thoughts, I don’t think I want to go out tonight.
examples.cn: 其实再想想,我今晚不打算出去了。

core: 他们自己; 她们自己; 它们自己
meaning: pron.他们自己; 她们自己; 它们自己.

exam.en: Some people may take advantage of it and benefit themselves.
exam.cn: 有些人可能会利用它来为自己谋利。

examples.en: Teachers have no choice but to take measures to protect themselves.
examples.cn: 教师们别无选择,只能采取措施来保护自己。

examples.en: Our neighbours have just bought themselves a jacuzzi.
examples.cn: 我们邻居刚刚买了一个按摩浴缸。

meaning: n.人; 个人; 本人.

exam.en: Falling into a routine can turn a person into an utter bore.
exam.cn: 陷入常规会把一个人变成十足的乏味之人。

examples.en: He was a very nice person, always pleasant and friendly.
examples.cn: 他是个很好的人,始终彬彬有礼。

examples.en: The only person who really said anything helpful was Jack.
examples.cn: 只有一个人真正说了些有用的话,就是杰克。

meaning: prep.没有; 不(做某事).

exam.en: They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help.
exam.cn: 没有专业帮助，他们无法戒除瘾症。

examples.en: After the storm we were without electricity for five days.
examples.cn: 暴风雨之后我们断电了五天。

examples.en: a house without a garden
examples.cn: 不带花园的房子

meaning: prep.在…之中; 在…中间.

exam.en: It exists mostly among children from poor families.
exam.cn: 它主要存在于贫困家庭的孩子中。

examples.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
examples.cn: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

examples.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
examples.cn: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

core: 假设; 认为; 猜想
meaning: v.假设; 认为; 猜想.

exam.en: Directions: Suppose your university student union is planning to hold a speech contest.
exam.cn: 说明：假设你们大学的学生会正计划举办一场演讲比赛。

examples.en: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
examples.cn: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

examples.en: (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
examples.cn: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

core: 健康; 卫生; 状况
meaning: n.健康; 卫生; 状况.

examples.en: I’m worried about my husband’s health.
examples.cn: 我担心我丈夫的健康状况。

core: 意味着; 表示...的意思; 打算
meaning: v.意味着; 表示...的意思; 打算. adj.吝啬的; 平均的. n.平均值.

meanings.cn: 意思是；意味着；平均的；吝啬的

exam.en: What does this mean for offices in cities?
exam.cn: 这对城市里的办公室意味着什么？

examples.en: He’s too mean to buy a present for his wife.
examples.cn: 他很吝啬,给他妻子买件礼物都不肯。

examples.en: What does ‘patronizing’ mean?
examples.cn: patronizing是什么意思?

meaning: adj.可能的; 适合的. adv.很可能.

exam.en: When people are bored, they're more likely to feel less meaning in their lives.
exam.cn: 当人们感到无聊时，他们更有可能觉得生活缺乏意义。

examples.en: the three most likely candidates for president
examples.cn: 最有可能当选的三位总统候选人

examples.en: One likely source of energy is windpower.
examples.cn: 有一种合适的能源就是风能。

core: 经验; 体验; 经历
meaning: n.经验; 体验; 经历. v.经历; 体验.

exam.en: The experience of using IT penetrates almost the entire work field.
exam.cn: 使用信息技术的经验几乎渗透了整个工作领域。

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.cn: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.cn: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

meaning: n.大量；许多；一批. pron.许多.

examples.en: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
examples.cn: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

examples.en: ‘How many CDs have you got?’ ‘Lots.’
examples.cn: “你有多少张CD?”“多着呢。”

core: 公众的; 公共的; 公开的
meaning: adj.公众的; 公共的; 公开的. n.公众; 民众.

exam.en: It runs counter to the public interest.
exam.cn: 它违背了公众利益。

examples.en: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
examples.cn: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

examples.en: full public access to information
examples.cn: 公众对信息的充分知情权

core: 例子; 范例; 榜样
meaning: n.例子; 范例; 榜样.

examples.en: Parents should set an example for their children.
examples.cn: 父母应该为孩子树立榜样。

examples.en: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
examples.cn: 许多国家,例如墨西哥和日本,经常发生地震。

meaning: conj.是否; 无论.

examples.en: Maurice asked me whether I needed any help.
examples.cn: 莫里斯问我是否需要帮助。

examples.en: There were times when I wondered whether or not we would get there.
examples.cn: 有时候我也想知道我们能不能做得到。

meaning: n.焦点; 重点. v.聚焦; 集中.

exam.en: What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research?
exam.cn: 奥基夫教授近期研究的重点是什么？

examples.en: The focus of recent research has been on environmental issues.
examples.cn: 近期的研究重点是环境问题。

examples.en: Eggs became the focus for the food poisoning scare.
examples.cn: 鸡蛋成了食物中毒恐慌的焦点。

core: 避免; 回避; 防止
meaning: vt.避免; 回避; 防止.

exam.en: Avoid taking unnecessary risks when starting a business.
exam.cn: 创业时要避免冒不必要的风险。

examples.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
examples.cn: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育,以避免交通事故。

examples.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
examples.cn: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

core: 观点; 看法; 视野; 景色
meaning: n.观点; 看法; 视野; 景色. v.观看; 看待.

exam.en: What is the popular view of obesity?
exam.cn: 关于肥胖的普遍看法是什么？

examples.en: In my view, the country needs a change of government.
examples.cn: 依我看,这个国家需要换个政府。

examples.en: an opportunity to view the film before it goes on general release
examples.cn: 在影片公映之前观影的机会

meaning: adj.社会的; 社交的.

exam.en: Post pictures of her pet dog on social media.
exam.cn: 在社交媒体上发布她宠物狗的照片。

examples.en: social issues, such as unemployment and education
examples.cn: 失业和教育之类的社会问题

examples.en: the country’s serious social problems
examples.cn: 该国严重的社会问题

core: 技能; 技巧; 熟练
meaning: n.技能; 技巧; 熟练.

exam.en: It is a rare skill often found in fluid organisations.
exam.cn: 这是一种在灵活型组织中常见的稀有技能。

examples.en: Reading and writing are two different skills.
examples.cn: 阅读和写作是两种不同的技能。

examples.en: Many jobs today require computer skills.
examples.cn: 如今的许多工作都需要计算机技能。

core: 工作; 职业; 任务
meaning: n.工作; 职业; 任务.

exam.en: It makes the hostess's job a whole lot easier.
exam.cn: 这让女主人的工作轻松了很多。

examples.en: Do you enjoy your job?
examples.cn: 你喜欢自己的工作吗?

examples.en: It was the first paid job I ever had.
examples.cn: 这是我第一份拿工资的工作。

core: 商业; 生意; 企业; 事务
meaning: n.商业; 生意; 企业; 事务.

exam.en: By inviting business leaders to help design curriculums.
exam.cn: 通过邀请商界领袖来帮助设计课程。

examples.en: Students on the course learn about all aspects of business.
examples.cn: 这门课程的学生要学习商业活动的各个方面。

examples.en: Carl began in the music business by running a recording studio.
examples.cn: 卡尔是从经营录音棚开始干音乐这一行的。

meaning: v.吃; 进食.

exam.en: Follow their intuition in deciding what to eat.
exam.cn: 凭直觉决定吃什么。

examples.en: Felix chatted cheerfully as he ate.
examples.cn: 费利克斯一边吃一边兴奋地聊天。

examples.en: A small girl was eating an ice cream.
examples.cn: 一个小女孩在吃冰激凌。

core: 健康的；有益健康的；明智的
meaning: adj.健康的；有益健康的；明智的.

exam.en: It also helps them develop healthy ideas around gender.
exam.cn: 它也有助于他们形成关于性别的健康观念。

examples.en: a healthy baby boy
examples.cn: 健康的男婴

examples.en: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
examples.cn: 直到现在,我的身体一直非常健康。

core: 地方; 地点; 位置
meaning: n.地方; 地点; 位置. v.放置; 安置.

exam.en: That's still a good place to start.
exam.cn: 那依然是一个好的起点。

examples.en: Make sure you keep the key in a safe place.
examples.cn: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

examples.en: I’ve spent the day dashing about from place to place.
examples.cn: 我这一天尽是在东奔西跑。

meaning: adj.人的; 人类的. n.人.

exam.en: Human numerical instincts are not so superior to those of other mammals as is generally believed.
exam.cn: 人类的数字本能并不像人们普遍认为的那样比其他哺乳动物优越得多。

examples.en: There are many different cell types in the human body .
examples.cn: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

examples.en: the power of the human mind
examples.cn: 人脑的威力

core: 大的; 大量的; 大规模的
meaning: adj.大的; 大量的; 大规模的.

exam.en: She ordered a large number of dolls.
exam.cn: 她订购了大量的玩偶。

examples.en: Los Angeles is the second largest city in the US.
examples.cn: 洛杉矶是美国的第二大城市。

examples.en: The T-shirt comes in Small, Medium and Large.
examples.cn: 这种T恤有小号、中号和大号。

core: 发展; 开发; 培育
meaning: v.发展; 开发; 培育.

exam.en: Develop a new strain of coffee bean.
exam.cn: 培育一种新的咖啡豆品种。

examples.en: Knowledge in the field of genetics has been developing very rapidly.
examples.cn: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

examples.en: Corsica has developed its economy around the tourist industry.
examples.cn: 科西嘉岛的经济是围绕旅游业发展起来的。

core: 水平; 程度; 级别
meaning: n.水平; 程度; 级别. adj.平的. v.使平坦.

exam.en: It has reached the highest level of evolution.
exam.cn: 它已经达到了进化的最高水平。

examples.en: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.
examples.cn: 通货膨胀降至30年来最低点。

examples.en: The floors in the old house were not completely level.
examples.cn: 老房子的地面不是完全平整的。

core: 享受; 喜爱; 享有
meaning: v.享受; 喜爱; 享有.

exam.en: They were more eager to enjoy a movie.
exam.cn: 他们更渴望去看一场电影。

examples.en: The average German will enjoy 40 days' paid holiday this year.
examples.cn: 德国人今年平均将享有40天带薪假期。

examples.en: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
examples.cn: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

meaning: n.事实; 真相.

exam.en: People agree to do too many things they are in fact unwilling to do.
exam.cn: 人们同意去做太多他们其实并不愿意做的事情。

examples.en: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
examples.cn: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆,是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

meaning: n.新闻; 消息.

exam.en: This is bad news for the losers.
exam.cn: 这对失败者来说是个坏消息。

examples.en: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
examples.cn: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

core: 公司; 陪伴; 同伴
meaning: n.公司; 陪伴; 同伴.

exam.en: How long people usually stayed in a company.
exam.cn: 人们通常在一家公司待多久。

examples.en: Which company do you work for?
examples.cn: 你在哪家公司上班?

examples.en: I called the phone company about the bill.
examples.cn: 我就电话账单的事给电话公司打了电话。

core: 成本; 代价; 费用
meaning: n.成本; 代价; 费用. v.花费; 使付出.

exam.en: Calculate the cost of the paint job.
exam.cn: 计算油漆工作的成本。

examples.en: We’ll get the plan costed before presenting it to the board.
examples.cn: 在把计划提交董事会以前,我们会核算成本。

examples.en: I offered to pay the cost of the taxi.
examples.cn: 我提出支付出租车费。

core: 想法; 主意; 观念
meaning: n.想法; 主意; 观念.

exam.en: Enable them to remember the main idea.
exam.cn: 让他们能够记住主旨大意。

examples.en: You should talk to Ken – he's always full of good ideas.
examples.cn: 你应该和肯谈谈,他总是满脑子好主意。

examples.en: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
examples.cn: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

core: 建议; 提议; 暗示
meaning: vt.建议; 提议; 暗示.

exam.en: What does the author suggest teachers do in the classroom?
exam.cn: 作者建议教师在课堂上做什么？

examples.en: The zoo asked its visitors to suggest a name for the new baby panda.
examples.cn: 动物园请游客提建议,给刚出生的大熊猫起一个名字。

examples.en: It has been suggested that the manager will resign if any more players are sold.
examples.cn: 有人提议,如果再有球员被出售,球队主教练就辞职。

core: 改善; 提高; 变得更好
meaning: v.改善; 提高; 变得更好.

exam.en: It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being.
exam.cn: 它对改善动物的福祉帮助很大。

examples.en: a course for students wishing to improve their English
examples.cn: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

examples.en: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
examples.cn: 医生说她正在康复。

core: 影响; 感动; 侵袭
meaning: vt.影响; 感动; 侵袭.

exam.en: It may affect obese people's quality of life.
exam.cn: 它可能会影响肥胖者的生活质量。

examples.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
examples.cn: 受飓风影响的地区

examples.en: a disease that affects the central nervous system
examples.cn: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

core: 支持; 支援; 供养
meaning: n.支持; 支援; 供养. vt.支持; 支撑; 赡养.

exam.en: They are places where students receive counseling and other support.
exam.cn: 这些地方是学生接受咨询和其他支持的地方。

examples.en: The bill was supported by a large majority in the Senate.
examples.cn: 这项法案得到参议院绝大多数人的支持。

examples.en: We strongly support the peace process.
examples.cn: 我们大力拥护和平进程。

meaning: n.手; 帮助; 指针. v.递; 交给.

exam.en: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.
exam.cn: 意志力和习惯是相辅相成的。

examples.en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
examples.cn: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

examples.en: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
examples.cn: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

meaning: n.发现; 调查结果. v.找到(find 的现在分词).

exam.en: What is the finding of the new study?
exam.cn: 这项新研究的发现是什么？

examples.en: Surveys conducted in other countries reported similar findings.
examples.cn: 在其他国家进行的调查也报告说有类似的结果。

meaning: adv.以前; 之前.

exam.en: She lost it about three days ago.
exam.cn: 她大约三天前丢了它。

examples.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (= a fairly long time ago ) .
examples.cn: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

examples.en: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
examples.cn: 不久前,我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

core: 短文; 散文; 论说文
meaning: n.短文; 散文; 论说文.

exam.en: You are now to write an essay for submission.
exam.cn: 你现在要写一篇文章提交。

examples.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
examples.cn: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

meaning: n.会话; 交谈.

exam.en: At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions.
exam.cn: 在每段对话结束时，你会听到四个问题。

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.cn: 电话交谈

examples.en: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
examples.cn: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

meaning: n.自己；自我；本人.

exam.en: It results from a lack of self-control.
exam.cn: 它源于缺乏自控力。

examples.en: a child’s developing sense of self
examples.cn: 儿童逐渐形成的自我意识

core: 年龄; 时代; 老年
meaning: n.年龄; 时代; 老年. v.变老; 老化.

exam.en: People's interests tend to change with age.
exam.cn: 人们的兴趣往往会随着年龄增长而改变。

examples.en: Francis is the same age as me.
examples.cn: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

examples.en: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
examples.cn: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

meaning: n.将来; 未来. adj.未来的.

exam.en: Prepare students to be competitive in the future.
exam.cn: 培养学生，使其在未来具有竞争力。

examples.en: The islands should have the right to decide their own future.
examples.cn: 这些岛屿应当有权决定自己的未来。

examples.en: a leader who will shape the organization’s future
examples.cn: 将决定该组织未来的一位领导者

core: 影响; 效果; 作用
meaning: n.影响; 效果; 作用. v.使发生; 引起.

exam.en: It examines the effect of cholesterol on people's health.
exam.cn: 它研究了胆固醇对人体健康的影响。

examples.en: the long-term effects of the drug
examples.cn: 这种毒品的长期影响

examples.en: I could feel the effects of the thin mountain air.
examples.cn: 我能感觉到山上稀薄空气产生的影响。

core: 地方的; 当地的; 局部的
meaning: adj.地方的; 当地的; 局部的. n.当地人.

exam.en: Provide free meals to the local poor.
exam.cn: 为当地的穷人提供免费餐食。

examples.en: We asked one of the locals to recommend a restaurant.
examples.cn: 我们请一位当地人推荐一家餐馆。

examples.en: local hospital
examples.cn: 当地医院

meaning: vi.倾向于; 往往会. vt.照料; 护理.

exam.en: People's interests tend to change with age.
exam.cn: 人们的兴趣往往随着年龄变化而变化。

examples.en: Sofia was in the bedroom tending to her son.
examples.cn: 索菲娅在卧室里照料她的儿子。

examples.en: A problem for manufacturers is that lighter cars tend to be noisy.
examples.cn: 制造商遇到的一个问题是重量较轻的汽车往往噪音大。

core: 学期; 术语; 期限; 条款
meaning: n.学期; 术语; 期限; 条款.

examples.en: Teachers often feel overworked in term time (= during the term ) .
examples.cn: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

core: 减少; 降低; 缩小
meaning: v.减少; 降低; 缩小.

exam.en: It can reduce companies' real estate costs.
exam.cn: 它可以降低公司的房地产成本。

examples.en: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
examples.cn: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

examples.en: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
examples.cn: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

core: 过程; 进程; 步骤
meaning: n.过程; 进程; 步骤. v.处理; 加工.

exam.en: It is a dynamic and self-improving process.
exam.cn: 这是一个动态且自我完善的过程。

examples.en: Goats’ cheese may be processed in many ways.
examples.cn: 山羊奶干酪可以有多种加工方法。

examples.en: Two million workers are employed processing goods for electronic firms.
examples.cn: 200 万名工人受雇为电子公司加工产品。

meaning: adj.能够; 有能力的.

exam.en: They are able to bring their potential into fuller play.
exam.cn: 他们能够更充分地发挥自己的潜力。

examples.en: one of my more able students
examples.cn: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

core: 驾驶; 驱动; 迫使
meaning: v.驾驶; 驱动; 迫使. n.驾驶; 驱动器; 动力.

exam.en: He noticed the driver was too young to drive.
exam.cn: 他注意到那位司机太年轻了，不能开车。

examples.en: the man driving the car
examples.cn: 开车的男子

examples.en: Can you drive?
examples.cn: 你会开车吗?

meaning: n.脸; 表面. v.面对; 面向.

exam.en: She has to face a criminal charge.
exam.cn: 她不得不面临一项刑事指控。

examples.en: She had a beautiful face.
examples.cn: 她面容秀美。

examples.en: Her face was white with fear.
examples.cn: 她吓得脸煞白。

meaning: adj.可能的; 合理的.

exam.en: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
exam.cn: 尽快纠正他们的错误。

examples.en: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
examples.cn: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票?

examples.en: It might be possible for the documents to be sent over.
examples.cn: 这些文件也许可以发送过去。

meaning: adj.相似的; 类似的.

exam.en: They are similar in terms of social skills.
exam.cn: 他们在社交技能方面相似。

examples.en: We have similar tastes in music.
examples.cn: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

examples.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
examples.cn: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

core: 使卷入, 牵涉；包含, 含有
meaning: v. 使卷入, 牵涉；包含, 含有

examples.en: What will the job involve?
examples.cn: 这份工作包括什么?

examples.en: I didn’t realize putting on a play involved so much work.
examples.cn: 我没想到上演一出戏剧需要做这么多的工作。

meaning: n.风险; 危险. v.冒险做; 冒…的风险.

exam.en: They are more willing to risk their own lives.
exam.cn: 他们更愿意拿自己的生命冒险。

examples.en: It was a risk, sending a letter to my house.
examples.cn: 将信寄到我家是冒险。

examples.en: Meat from the infected animals is regarded as a serious health risk (= something likely to harm people’s health ) .
examples.cn: 受感染动物的肉被认为对健康有严重威胁。

meaning: n.成功; 成就.

exam.en: How people viewed success in his father's time.
exam.cn: 在他父亲那个年代，人们是如何看待成功的。

examples.en: The experiment was a big success.
examples.cn: 实验非常成功。

meaning: n.组; 团体; 群. v.分组; 聚集.

exam.en: She has been attending some group classes.
exam.cn: 她一直在上一些小组课程。

examples.en: A group of us are going to London.
examples.cn: 我们有一群人要去伦敦。

core: 课程; 过程; 路线; 一道菜
meaning: n.课程; 过程; 路线; 一道菜.

exam.en: They varied greatly among the course participants.
exam.cn: 在课程参与者当中，情况千差万别。

core: 关系; 关联; 恋爱关系
meaning: n.关系; 关联; 恋爱关系.

exam.en: They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
exam.cn: 他们可能将任何分歧视为一段关系的终结。

examples.en: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
examples.cn: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

core: 形式; 形状; 表格
meaning: n.形式; 形状; 表格. v.形成; 组成.

exam.en: They are to be confirmed in written form.
exam.cn: 它们需以书面形式确认。

examples.en: We oppose racism in all its forms.
examples.cn: 我们反对各种形式的种族主义。

examples.en: Vitamin C can be taken in capsule or tablet form .
examples.cn: 补充维生素C可以服用胶囊,也可以服用片剂。

core: 兴趣; 利益; 利息
meaning: n.兴趣; 利益; 利息. v.使感兴趣.

exam.en: It runs counter to the public interest.
exam.cn: 这违背了公众利益。

examples.en: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
examples.cn: 我看了前几集,但很快就失去了兴趣。

examples.en: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
examples.cn: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

core: 简单地; 仅仅; 简直; 朴素地
meaning: adv.简单地; 仅仅; 简直; 朴素地.

exam.en: It simply focuses on nutrition and health.
exam.cn: 它仅仅关注营养和健康。

examples.en: This work is simply not good enough.
examples.cn: 这工作做得实在不够好。

examples.en: He simply won’t accept the committee’s decision.
examples.cn: 他根本不接受委员会的决定。

core: 放置; 表达; 使处于(某种状态)
meaning: v.放置; 表达; 使处于(某种状态).

exam.en: They put jam instead of butter on bread.
exam.cn: 他们在面包上抹果酱而不是黄油。

examples.en: He put the coffee on the table.
examples.cn: 他把咖啡放在桌上。

examples.en: Where did you put the programmes?
examples.cn: 你把节目单放在哪里了?

core: 差异; 不同; 差额
meaning: n.差异; 不同; 差额.

exam.en: Help eliminate class difference in his area.
exam.cn: 帮助消除他所在地区的阶级差异。

examples.en: (= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
examples.cn: 我们之间有着天壤之别。

examples.en: an adventure holiday with a difference
examples.cn: 非同一般的历险度假

meaning: n.缺乏; 不足. v.缺乏; 没有.

exam.en: It results from a lack of self-control.
exam.cn: 它源于缺乏自控力。

examples.en: Alex’s real problem is that he lacks confidence.
examples.cn: 亚历克斯的真正问题是缺乏信心。

examples.en: Too many teachers are treated with a lack of respect.
examples.cn: 有太多老师得不到尊重。

core: 情况; 案件; 箱子
meaning: n.情况; 案件; 箱子.

exam.en: It is bringing the case to the local district court.
exam.cn: 它正将此案提交给当地地方法院。

examples.en: We tend to think of these people as untrustworthy, but that is not the case.
examples.cn: 我们往往会认为这些人不可靠,但事实并非如此。

examples.en: Tom’s career is a case in point (= a clear example of something that you are discussing or explaining ) .
examples.cn: 汤姆的事业就是个明证。

core: 确信的; 肯定的; 必定的
meaning: adj.确信的; 肯定的; 必定的. adv.当然(make sure 确保).

exam.en: No matter what, make sure you are having fun in life.
exam.cn: 无论如何，要确保你在生活中是快乐的。

examples.en: ‘That’s Sarah’s cousin.’ ‘Are you sure?’
examples.cn: “那是萨拉的表妹。”“你肯定吗?”

examples.en: ‘What time does the show start?’ ‘I’m not sure.’
examples.cn: “表演什么时候开始?”“我说不准。”

meaning: adj.足够的; 充足的. adv.足够地; 充分地. pron.足够.

exam.en: For them, the medical model isn't enough.
exam.cn: 对他们而言，医学模式是不够的。

examples.en: Are the carrots cooked enough?
examples.cn: 胡萝卜煮熟了吗?

examples.en: He just hadn’t thought enough about the possible consequences.
examples.cn: 他就是没有充分考虑可能造成的后果。

core: 注意力; 关心; 关注
meaning: n.注意力; 关心; 关注.

exam.en: Pay attention to the differences between genders.
exam.cn: 注意两性之间的差异。

examples.en: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
examples.cn: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

examples.en: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
examples.cn: 她尽量注意听他说话。

core: 确定的; 某个; 肯定的
meaning: adj.确定的; 某个; 肯定的.

exam.en: You've spent your whole life building your identity under a certain name.
exam.cn: 你一生都在用某个特定的名字塑造自己的身份。

examples.en: I felt certain that I’d passed the test.
examples.cn: 我感觉自己肯定通过这次测验了。

meaning: vt.使能够; 使可行.

exam.en: Enable them to remember the main idea.
exam.cn: 使他们能够记住主旨大意。

examples.en: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
examples.cn: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

core: 简单的; 简易的; 朴素的
meaning: adj.简单的; 简易的; 朴素的.

exam.en: The concept of self-care, at its core, is quite simple.
exam.cn: 自我关怀的核心概念其实很简单。

examples.en: a simple but effective solution to the problem
examples.cn: 对这个问题简单而有效的解决办法

examples.en: There is no simple answer to this question.
examples.cn: 这个问题没有简单的答案。

meaning: det.几个; 数个. pron.几个.

exam.en: It interrupted traffic for several hours running.
exam.cn: 它连续中断了交通好几个小时。

examples.en: They shook hands and went their several ways (= went in different directions ) .
examples.cn: 他们握了握手便各自走了。

meaning: v./n.奋斗; 挣扎; 斗争.

exam.en: And some people may struggle to get the same access to certain foods.
exam.cn: 而有些人可能难以获得同样的某些食物。

examples.en: The team has been struggling all season.
examples.cn: 整个赛季球队都打得很艰难。

examples.en: They had to struggle against all kinds of adversity.
examples.cn: 他们不得不同各种困境斗争。

core: 决定; 决策; 决断力
meaning: n.决定; 决策; 决断力.

exam.en: Making the decision is just part of the process.
exam.cn: 做出决定只是过程的一部分。

examples.en: Do you ever wonder if you made the right decision?
examples.cn: 你怀疑过自己所作的决定是否正确吗?

examples.en: The judges’ decision is final (= it will not be changed ) .
examples.cn: 法官的裁决是最终判决。

core: 小孩；小山羊；小山羊皮制的
meaning: n. 小孩；小山羊 adj. 小山羊皮制的

examples.en: She’d always loved animals since she was a little kid.
examples.cn: 她从小就喜爱动物。

examples.en: He’s married with three kids.
examples.cn: 他已婚,有三个孩子。

meaning: n.能力; 才能.

examples.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
examples.cn: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

core: 任务; 工作; 作业
meaning: n.任务; 工作; 作业.

exam.en: It is found that people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task.
exam.cn: 研究发现，人们在完成一项乏味的任务后会更有创造力。

examples.en: Jen was tasked with running a charity basketball tournament.
examples.cn: 珍被委以举办一场慈善篮球赛的任务。

examples.en: Sara had the task of preparing the agenda for meetings.
examples.cn: 萨拉的任务是准备会议议程。

meaning: n.调查; 勘测. v.调查.

exam.en: What did the Common Sense Media survey reveal?
exam.cn: 常识媒体调查揭示了什么？

examples.en: Of the 100 companies surveyed, 10% had a turnover of £50 m to £99 m.
examples.cn: 被调查的 100 家公司中,10% 的公司营业额在 5,000 万到 9,900 万英镑之间。

core: 照顾; 小心; 护理
meaning: n.照顾; 小心; 护理. v.关心; 在意.

exam.en: Provide their pets with the best care.
exam.cn: 给他们的宠物提供最好的照顾。

examples.en: ‘He looked angry.’ ‘ I don’t care !’
examples.cn: “他好像很生气。”“我不管!”

examples.en: high standards of medical care
examples.cn: 高水平的医疗护理

meaning: n.状态; 州; 国家. v.陈述; 声明.

exam.en: He acted in violation of the state law.
exam.cn: 他的行为违反了州法律。

examples.en: She was in an extremely confused state of mind .
examples.cn: 她思绪纷乱。

examples.en: She can’t go home now. Look at the state of her!
examples.cn: 她现在不能回家。看看她这副样子!

meaning: n.影响; 冲击. v.影响; 冲击.

meanings.cn: 影响, 作用, 冲击

examples.en: The force of the impact knocked the breath out of her.
examples.cn: 撞击力使她喘不过气来。

examples.en: Such schemes mean little unless they impact people.
examples.cn: 除非能对人们造成影响,否则这样的计划意义不大。

core: 原因; 理由; 理性
meaning: n.原因; 理由; 理性. v.推理; 思考.

exam.en: For this reason, it can be helpful to be gracious in your response.
exam.cn: 出于这个原因，在回应时保持宽厚是有益的。

examples.en: She has reason to feel guilty.
examples.cn: 她有理由感到内疚。

examples.en: They reasoned that other businesses would soon copy the idea.
examples.cn: 他们推断其他企业也会很快仿效这个点子。

core: 近的; 接近的; 亲密的
meaning: adj.近的; 接近的; 亲密的. v.关; 关闭.

exam.en: It is quite close to her house.
exam.cn: 它离她家相当近。

examples.en: If you need to buy bread or milk, the closest shop is about a mile away.
examples.cn: 如果你需要买面包或牛奶,最近的商店大概有一英里远。

examples.en: His eyes were small and close together .
examples.cn: 他眼睛很小,而且挨得很近。

meaning: adj.个人的; 个体的. n.个人; 个体.

examples.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
examples.cn: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

examples.en: the needs of the individual customer
examples.cn: 每位顾客的需求

core: 地区; 区域; 面积; 领域
meaning: n.地区; 区域; 面积; 领域.

exam.en: He is now kept in a secure area.
exam.cn: 他现在被关在一个安全区域。

examples.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
examples.cn: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

examples.en: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
examples.cn: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

core: 流行的; 受欢迎的; 大众的
meaning: adj.流行的; 受欢迎的; 大众的.

exam.en: It is the most popular in Spain.
exam.cn: 它在西班牙是最受欢迎的。

examples.en: Hilary was popular at school.
examples.cn: 希拉里在学校里很受欢迎。

examples.en: a popular holiday resort
examples.cn: 人们喜欢的度假胜地

meaning: adj.现在的; 流动的. n.(水、气、电)流; 趋势.

exam.en: What do we need to do if we keep consuming fish at the current rate?
exam.cn: 如果我们以目前的速度继续吃鱼，我们需要做什么？

examples.en: the current President
examples.cn: 现任总统

examples.en: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
examples.cn: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

meaning: adj.困难的; 难懂的.

exam.en: It was difficult to keep a job for long.
exam.cn: 很难长久地保住一份工作。

examples.en: a difficult question
examples.cn: 难解的问题

examples.en: an immensely difficult task
examples.cn: 极为艰巨的任务

meaning: n.数量; 总额. vi.总计; 相当于.

exam.en: Reduce the amount of plastic pollution in local areas.
exam.cn: 减少当地塑料污染的数量。

examples.en: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to $9.75 billion.
examples.cn: 消费者在体育相关用品上的消费总共达到了97.5亿美元。

examples.en: Please pay the full amount (= of money ) by the end of the month.
examples.cn: 请在月底前全额付清。

core: 要点; 观点; 得分; 尖端
meaning: n.要点; 观点; 得分; 尖端. v.指向; 指出.

exam.en: We can point to at least three potential causes.
exam.cn: 我们至少可以指出三个潜在原因。

examples.en: ‘Look!’ she said and pointed.
examples.cn: “看呀!”她用手指着说道。

examples.en: She pointed in the direction of the car park.
examples.cn: 她指着停车场的方向。

meaning: n.角色; 作用.

exam.en: The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.
exam.cn: 教师在激励儿童学习方面的作用。

examples.en: She has just landed the lead role in their latest production.
examples.cn: 她刚在他们最新的作品中取得了主角。

examples.en: Until now scientists had very little clear evidence about the drug's role in preventing more serious effects of infection.
examples.cn: 到目前为止,科学家们几乎没有该药物在防止更严重的感染后果的功能的明确证据。

core: 比较, 对照；把……………………比作；比较
meaning: v. 比较, 对照；把…………比作 n. 比较

examples.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
examples.cn: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

examples.en: a beauty and an elegance beyond compare
examples.cn: 无与伦比的美丽与优雅

meaning: n.过去; 往事. adj.过去的; 结束的. prep.经过; 超过.

exam.en: Draw on a vast wealth of past experience.
exam.cn: 借鉴大量过去的经验。

examples.en: You mustn’t think about it. It’s all in the past now.
examples.cn: 你千万不要再想那件事,现在一切都过去了。

examples.en: Judging by her past performance, Jane should do very well.
examples.cn: 从以往的表现来看,简应该会干得很好。

meaning: v. 遭受；忍受；受苦；遭受 n. (Suffer)人名；(意)苏费尔

examples.en: At least he died suddenly and didn’t suffer.
examples.cn: 至少他死得突然,没有遭罪。

examples.en: She’s suffering a lot of pain.
examples.cn: 她遭受着巨大的痛苦。

meaning: adv.几乎; 差不多.

exam.en: He spent almost all his time traveling.
exam.cn: 他把几乎所有时间都花在了旅行上。

examples.en: Have you almost finished?
examples.cn: 你差不多完成了吗?

examples.en: Supper’s almost ready.
examples.cn: 晚饭就要做好了。

core: 尤其; 特别; 格外
meaning: adv.尤其; 特别; 格外.

exam.en: Nightmares are part of the human experience, especially for kids.
exam.cn: 噩梦是人类体验的一部分，尤其是对孩子来说。

examples.en: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
examples.cn: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步,尤其在冬天。

examples.en: Art books are expensive to produce, especially if they contain colour illustrations.
examples.cn: 美术类书籍制作成本很高,尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

meaning: v. 出版；发表

examples.en: The first edition was published in 1765.
examples.cn: 第一版于1765年出版。

examples.en: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
examples.cn: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

core: 活动; 活跃; 行动
meaning: n.活动; 活跃; 行动.

exam.en: They installed a camera to monitor sheep activity.
exam.cn: 他们安装了一台摄像机来监控羊群的活动。

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.cn: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.cn: 筹款活动

meaning: n.科学; 学科.

examples.en: Many leading scientists do not consider that science can give absolutely reliable knowledge.
examples.cn: 许多杰出科学家都不认为科学能够提供绝对可靠的知识。

examples.en: the founder of modern science, Isaac Newton
examples.cn: 现代科学创始人艾萨克·牛顿

core: 贡献; 捐献; 促成
meaning: v.贡献; 捐献; 促成.

examples.en: The three sons also contribute to the family business.
examples.cn: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

examples.en: The U.S. is contributing $4 billion in loans, credits, and grants.
examples.cn: 美国以信贷和赠与的方式捐助了40亿美元。

core: 分享; 分担; n.一份; 份额
meaning: v.分享; 分担; n.一份; 份额.

exam.en: Create opportunities for employees to share success stories.
exam.cn: 为员工创造分享成功故事的机会。

examples.en: As a kid he’d never share his toys.
examples.cn: 他小时候从不肯与人分享他的玩具。

examples.en: We don’t have enough books so you’ll have to share.
examples.cn: 我们书不够,所以你们得合着用。

meaning: n. 十年,十年期；十

examples.en: ……the last decade of the nineteenth century.
examples.cn: ……19世纪的最后10年。

meaning: n.种类; 仁慈. adj.友好的; 善良的.

exam.en: It is the best kind of hard cheese.
exam.cn: 它是最好的一种硬质奶酪。

examples.en: Get me a sandwich – any kind will do.
examples.cn: 给我一份三明治,随便哪种都可以。

examples.en: It wasn’t a very kind thing to say.
examples.cn: 这么说可不太客气。

core: 穿过; 横过; 在…对面
meaning: prep.穿过; 横过; 在…对面. adv.从一边到另一边; 在对面.

examples.en: We can gain some time if we cut across this field.
examples.cn: 我们如果抄近路穿过这片田野可以省下一些时间。

meaning: n. 因素；系数

examples.en: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
examples.cn: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

core: 状况; 条件; 环境
meaning: n.状况; 条件; 环境. v.训练; 使适应.

exam.en: They are responsible for their own condition.
exam.cn: 他们对自己的状况负责。

examples.en: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
examples.cn: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

examples.en: In May, staff went on strike, demanding better pay and conditions .
examples.cn: 五月份员工举行了罢工,要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

core: 努力; 尽力; 努力的成果
meaning: n.努力; 尽力; 努力的成果.

exam.en: More people will be willing to join in the effort.
exam.cn: 会有更多人愿意加入这一努力。

examples.en: please make an effort to be polite.
examples.cn: 请尽量礼貌些。

examples.en: Church leaders are prepared to meet the terrorists in an effort to (= in order to try to ) find peace.
examples.cn: 为寻求和平,教会领袖准备与恐怖分子会面。

core: 收到; 接到; 接收
meaning: v.收到; 接到; 接收.

exam.en: Farmers ring up to receive the information.
exam.cn: 农民们打电话来获取信息。

examples.en: All the children will receive a small gift.
examples.cn: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

examples.en: Lee received 324 votes (= 324 people voted for him ) .
examples.cn: 李得到324票。

meaning: vt.鼓励; 激励.

exam.en: Encourage them to make things with hands.
exam.cn: 鼓励他们动手制作东西。

examples.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
examples.cn: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

meaning: v.&n.旅行; 行进.

examples.en: They travelled 200 miles on the first day.
examples.cn: 他们第一天行进了200英里。

core: 强壮的; 坚固的; 强烈的; 坚强的
meaning: adj.强壮的; 坚固的; 强烈的; 坚强的.

exam.en: They have strong negative emotions towards math.
exam.cn: 他们对数学有强烈的负面情绪。

examples.en: He was a big strong man.
examples.cn: 他高大健壮。

examples.en: Jack was tall and strong.
examples.cn: 杰克又高又壮。

core: 机会; 可能性; 偶然
meaning: n.机会; 可能性; 偶然. v.冒险; 碰巧.

exam.en: They have a higher chance of joining sports teams.
exam.cn: 他们有更高的机会加入运动队。

examples.en: There’s always the chance that something will go wrong.
examples.cn: 总有可能会出现问题。

examples.en: If we did move to London, I’d stand a much better chance (= have a much better chance ) of getting a job.
examples.cn: 如果我们真的搬到伦敦去,我找到工作的机会就大多了。

meaning: vt.解决; 解答.

exam.en: It helps little to solve patients' problems.
exam.cn: 它对于解决病人们的问题几乎没有帮助。

examples.en: Charlie thinks money will solve all his problems.
examples.cn: 查理认为钱能解决他所有的问题。

examples.en: the best way of solving our dilemma
examples.cn: 解决我们两难处境的最佳办法

meaning: adv.很; 相当; 完全.

exam.en: They tend to eat quite a lot.
exam.cn: 他们往往吃得相当多。

examples.en: I felt quite bitter about it at the time.
examples.cn: 当时我对此感到相当痛苦。

examples.en: Well, actually it requires quite a bit of work and research.
examples.cn: 呃,实际上这需要相当多的工作和研究。

core: 技术; 工艺; 科技
meaning: n.技术; 工艺; 科技.

exam.en: Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products.
exam.cn: 改进的技术催生了非常受欢迎的产品。

examples.en: Modern technology makes moving money around much easier than it used to be.
examples.cn: 现代科技使货币流动比以前便捷得多。

examples.en: Advances in technology have improved crop yields by over 30%.
examples.cn: 科技的进步使庄稼产量提高了30%以上。

meaning: n.教育; 培养.

exam.en: The urgency of creating teacher education programs.
exam.cn: 创建教师教育项目的紧迫性。

examples.en: She also hopes her children will get a good education.
examples.cn: 她也希望她的孩子可以受到良好的教育。

examples.en: efforts to improve girls’ access to education
examples.cn: 为增加女孩受教育机会所作的努力

meaning: n. 科学家

examples.en: Scientists say they've already collected more data than had been expected.
examples.cn: 科学家们说他们已经搜集到比预期更多的数据。

core: 身体的; 物理的; 物质的
meaning: adj.身体的; 物理的; 物质的.

exam.en: Give the two pets a physical checkup.
exam.cn: 给这两只宠物做一次身体检查。

examples.en: She was in constant physical pain.
examples.cn: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

examples.en: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
examples.cn: 青年人的身心需求

core: 质量; 品质; 特性
meaning: n.质量; 品质; 特性. adj.优质的.

exam.en: It may affect obese people's quality of life.
exam.cn: 它可能会影响肥胖者的生活质量。

examples.en: Much of the land was of poor quality.
examples.cn: 很多地的土质很差。

examples.en: Use only high quality ingredients.
examples.cn: 只使用上等的材料。

meaning: n.习惯; 习性.

examples.en: Regular exercise is a good habit.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼是个好习惯。

examples.en: Thinking negatively can become a habit.
examples.cn: 消极的思维方式会成为一种习惯。

meaning: n.声音; 响声. v.听起来. adj.健康的; 健全的; 合理的.

exam.en: By ensuring that their mental health is sound.
exam.cn: 通过确保他们的心理健康是健全的。

examples.en: Several earlier studies had sounded similar warnings .
examples.cn: 早先的几次研究也提出过类似的警告。

examples.en: Now it is an American economist who is sounding the alarm .
examples.cn: 现在是一位美国的经济学家在提出警告。

meaning: n.平均数; 平均水平. adj.平均的; 普通的. v.平均为.

exam.en: It is ninety grams daily on average.
exam.cn: 它平均每天是九十克。

examples.en: The December figures brought the annual average for 2001 up to 10.6 per cent.
examples.cn: 12月的数据将2001年的年平均水平提升到10.6%。

examples.en: The age of the candidates ranged from 29 to 49 with an average age of 37.
examples.cn: 候选人的年龄29岁至49岁不等,平均37岁。

core: 身体; 躯体; 主体
meaning: n.身体; 躯体; 主体.

examples.en: the human body
examples.cn: 人体

examples.en: My fingers were numb and my whole body ached.
examples.cn: 我手指麻木,浑身疼痛。

core: 个人的; 私人的; 亲自的
meaning: adj.个人的; 私人的; 亲自的.

exam.en: It contributes to the formation of personal traits.
exam.cn: 它有助于个人特质的形成。

examples.en: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
examples.cn: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

examples.en: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
examples.cn: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

core: 相当; 宁愿; 更确切地说
meaning: adv.相当; 宁愿; 更确切地说.

exam.en: Many of them find it rather difficult to manage.
exam.cn: 他们许多人觉得这相当难应付。

examples.en: I grew up in rather unusual circumstances.
examples.cn: 我在相当不寻常的环境中长大。

examples.en: I'm afraid it's a rather long story.
examples.cn: 我恐怕这是个相当长的故事。

meaning: adv.代替; 反而.

examples.en: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
examples.cn: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

examples.en: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
examples.cn: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿?

core: 表演; 表现; 性能; 业绩
meaning: n.表演; 表现; 性能; 业绩.

exam.en: He followed various measures of performance over the next decade.
exam.cn: 他在接下来的十年里跟踪了各种绩效指标。

examples.en: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
examples.cn: 今晚的演出8点开始。

meaning: n.百分之…; 百分比.

exam.en: She said twenty percent of people are afraid to fly.
exam.cn: 她说百分之二十的人害怕坐飞机。

examples.en: But there are billions more people out there who are not in the top one percent, and they’re not in the top two or three either.
examples.cn: 但是还有十亿多的人不在其中,他们不在其中的百分之一,也不再其中的两百分之一或者三百分之一的其中。

examples.en: I agree with you one hundred percent.
examples.cn: 我百分之百地同意你的意见。

core: 实现; 达到; 取得
meaning: vt.实现; 达到; 取得.

exam.en: It is bound to help us achieve greater success.
exam.cn: 它必定能帮助我们取得更大的成功。

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.cn: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.cn: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

meaning: n. 挑战 v. 向…………挑战；对…………质疑

examples.en: They threw down the challenge that he couldn’t wash 40 cars in one hour (= invited him to try to do it ) .
examples.cn: 他们激将他,说他不可能在1小时内擦洗40辆汽车。

examples.en: The role will be the biggest challenge of his acting career.
examples.cn: 扮演这个角色将是他演艺生涯中最大的挑战。

core: 力量; 权力; 电力
meaning: n.力量; 权力; 电力. v.驱动; 提供动力.

meanings.cn: 借影响有权势人物以操纵权力的

exam.en: Brain power weakens slower than we imagine.
exam.cn: 脑力衰退的速度比我们想象的要慢。

examples.en: They seized power in a military coup.
examples.cn: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

examples.en: the pulling power (= ability to attract people or attention ) of major celebrities
examples.cn: 大名人的吸引力

core: 钥匙; 关键; 答案
meaning: n.钥匙; 关键; 答案. adj.关键的; 主要的.

exam.en: Choosing what to eat and drink is key to weight control.
exam.cn: 选择吃什么喝什么是控制体重的关键。

examples.en: A bunch of keys hung from his belt.
examples.cn: 他的皮带上挂着一串钥匙。

core: 问题; 议题; 发行物
meaning: n.问题; 议题; 发行物. v.发布; 发行.

exam.en: There are a couple of ways to compromise on the issue.
exam.cn: 在这个问题上，有几种妥协的办法。

examples.en: Silva issued a statement denying all knowledge of the affair.
examples.cn: 西尔瓦发表声明,宣称对此事一无所知。

examples.en: a warning issued by the Surgeon General
examples.cn: (美国)卫生局局长发出的警告

core: 反对; 逆; 倚; 防备
meaning: prep.反对; 逆; 倚; 防备.

exam.en: Bring policies against cheating up to date.
exam.cn: 更新反作弊政策。

examples.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
examples.cn: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

examples.en: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
examples.cn: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉,倚靠在办公桌旁。

core: 事情; 问题; 物质
meaning: n.事情; 问题; 物质. vi.要紧.

exam.en: No matter what, make sure you are having fun in life.
exam.cn: 无论如何，一定要确保你在生活中过得开心。

examples.en: If I have to stay late at work tonight, it won’t matter because we can go out another night.
examples.cn: 如果今晚我必须工作到很晚的话,那也没关系,我们可以改天晚上再出去。

examples.en: Does it matter what I think?
examples.cn: 我怎么想重要吗?

core: 提升; 举起; 养育; 筹集
meaning: vt.提升; 举起; 养育; 筹集.

exam.en: Why parents raise their children in different ways.
exam.cn: 为什么父母以不同的方式养育孩子。

examples.en: Can you raise the lamp so I can see?
examples.cn: 你能把灯举高点好让我看清吗?

examples.en: William raised his hat and smiled at her.
examples.cn: 威廉抬一抬帽子,朝她笑了笑。

meaning: n.选择; 选项.

meanings.cn: 选择, 选择权, 选择自由

exam.en: So we would prefer the more expensive option.
exam.cn: 所以我们宁愿要那个更贵的选择。

examples.en: There are a number of options available.
examples.cn: 有多种选择。

examples.en: He had two options.
examples.cn: 他有两种选择。

core: 社会; 社团; 社交界
meaning: n.社会; 社团; 社交界.

exam.en: Its impact on society is expected to rise.
exam.cn: 预计它对社会的影响将会上升。

examples.en: technology and its effects on modern society
examples.cn: 科技及其对现代社会的影响

examples.en: Children are the most vulnerable members of society .
examples.cn: 儿童是最脆弱的社会成员。

core: 整个的; 完整的; 全部的
meaning: adj.整个的; 完整的; 全部的. n.整体; 全部.

exam.en: It satisfied consumer demands on the whole.
exam.cn: 总体上它满足了消费者的需求。

examples.en: You have your whole life ahead of you!
examples.cn: 你有一辈子要过呢!

examples.en: His whole attitude bugs me.
examples.cn: 他的整个态度都让我讨厌。

meaning: adv.几乎; 将近.

exam.en: Nearly all of them serve the purpose of the funders.
exam.cn: 它们几乎全都服务于资助者的目的。

examples.en: It took nearly two hours to get here.
examples.cn: 到这里花了将近两小时。

examples.en: Michelle’s nearly twenty.
examples.cn: 米歇尔年近二十。

meaning: adj.错误的; 不正确的.

exam.en: She got off at the wrong station.
exam.cn: 她下错了站。

examples.en: You’ve spelt my name wrong.
examples.cn: 你把我的名字拼错了。

examples.en: What? Have I done it wrong ?
examples.cn: 什么?我做得不对吗?

meaning: n.多样化; 种类.

exam.en: Engage in a variety of psychological activities.
exam.cn: 参加各种各样的心理活动。

examples.en: I really like the variety the store has to offer.
examples.cn: 我很喜欢这家商店商品的丰富多样。

examples.en: West Hampstead has a variety of good stores and supermarkets.
examples.cn: 西汉普斯特德有几家不同的高品质商店和超市。

meaning: adj.清晰的; 清楚的. v.清除; 澄清.

exam.en: Clear up confusion in the scientific community.
exam.cn: 澄清科学界的困惑。

examples.en: clear instructions
examples.cn: 明确的指示

examples.en: The question wasn’t very clear.
examples.cn: 这问题不是很清楚。

meaning: n. 收获 v. 获得；增加

examples.en: The Democratic Party needed a net gain of only 20 votes.
examples.cn: 民主党只需要增20张选票。

examples.en: Eating too many fatty foods could cause weight gain.
examples.cn: 过多食用高脂食物会导致体重增加。

core: 可能; 也许; 大概
meaning: adv.可能; 也许; 大概.

exam.en: Maybe they are actually little miracles," he says.
exam.cn: “也许它们其实是小小的奇迹，”他说。

examples.en: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
examples.cn: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

examples.en: ‘Do you think he’ll come back?’ ‘Maybe.’
examples.cn: “你认为他会回来吗?”“也许会吧。”

meaning: adj.巨大的; 庞大的.

exam.en: It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation.
exam.cn: 它释放出大量的有害辐射。

examples.en: a huge dog
examples.cn: 一条大狗

examples.en: huge crowds
examples.cn: 大群大群的人

core: 日常饮食; 规定饮食
meaning: n.日常饮食; 规定饮食. v.节食.

exam.en: See that people don't stick to the same diet.
exam.cn: 要确保人们不会固守同样的饮食。

examples.en: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.
examples.cn: 琳恩似乎一直在节食。

examples.en: a salt-free diet
examples.cn: 无盐饮食

meaning: n.动物. adj.动物的.

exam.en: The urgency of joining an animal rights group.
exam.cn: 加入动物权益组织的紧迫性。

examples.en: furry little animals
examples.cn: 毛茸茸的小动物

examples.en: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
examples.cn: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

core: 目标; 目的; 球门; 得分
meaning: n.目标; 目的; 球门; 得分.

exam.en: It is still far from its goal despite the progress made.
exam.cn: 尽管取得了进展，它仍离目标很远。

examples.en: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
examples.cn: 身为父母,你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

meaning: n. 成年人 adj. 成年的；成熟的

examples.en: an adult lion
examples.cn: 一头成年的狮子

examples.en: the adult population
examples.cn: 成年人口

core: 贫穷的; 可怜的; 差的
meaning: adj.贫穷的; 可怜的; 差的.

exam.en: Provide free meals to the local poor.
exam.cn: 为当地穷人提供免费餐食。

examples.en: Poor kid, he’s had a rough day.
examples.cn: 可怜的孩子,今天他真倒霉。

examples.en: You poor thing , you’ve had a hard time of it, haven’t you?
examples.cn: 可怜的东西,你过得很苦,是不是?

meaning: n.价格; 代价. v.给……定价.

exam.en: To inquire about the price of office chairs.
exam.cn: 询问办公椅的价格。

examples.en: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
examples.cn: 为了短短几年的辉煌,他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

core: 类型; 种类; 典型
meaning: n.类型; 种类; 典型. v.打字.

exam.en: Could this reflective type of hair protect people?
exam.cn: 这种反射性的头发类型能保护人吗？

examples.en: Jo’s not really the sporty type.
examples.cn: 乔可不是那种喜欢运动的人。

examples.en: He types with two fingers.
examples.cn: 他用两个手指打字。

core: 感觉; 感官; 意义; 判断力
meaning: n.感觉; 感官; 意义; 判断力. v.感觉到; 意识到.

exam.en: And there it makes sense that failures show us the road to success.
exam.cn: 在那里，失败向我们展示成功之路是有道理的。

examples.en: Cats have a very acute sense of hearing (= very good, so that they can hear even the smallest sound ) .
examples.cn: 猫的听觉非常敏锐。

core: 比率; 速度; 价格
meaning: n.比率; 速度; 价格. v.评估; 划分等级.

exam.en: The divorce rate in the county has been on a steady rise.
exam.cn: 该县的离婚率一直在稳步上升。

examples.en: Immediately his heart rate (= the number of beats per minute ) increased.
examples.cn: 他的心率立即加快了。

examples.en: I never rated him.
examples.cn: 我从来都不认为他好。

core: 行动; 行为; 作用
meaning: n.行动; 行为; 作用.

exam.en: Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action.
exam.cn: 肥胖者不会觉得自己有责任采取任何行动。

examples.en: The government must take action (= do something ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.cn: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

examples.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (= doing the things she had planned ) .
examples.cn: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

core: 程序; 节目; 计划
meaning: n.程序; 节目; 计划. v.编程; 安排.

exam.en: He is a host for a TV program.
exam.cn: 他是一个电视节目的主持人。

examples.en: a word processing program
examples.cn: 文字处理程序

examples.en: Any large high-speed computer can be programmed to learn.
examples.cn: 任何大型高速计算机都可以通过编程获得学习能力。

core: 情况; 形势; 处境
meaning: n.情况; 形势; 处境.

exam.en: But the situation can be made better.
exam.cn: 但情况可以变得更好。

examples.en: I explained the situation to everyone.
examples.cn: 我向大家介绍了一下情况。

examples.en: The house is in a charming situation, on a wooded hillside.
examples.cn: 房子位于林木茂密的小山坡上,环境十分优美。

core: 顺序; 秩序; 命令; 订单
meaning: n.顺序; 秩序; 命令; 订单. v.命令; 订购; 整理.

examples.en: There seemed to be no logical order to the sections.
examples.cn: 这几部分似乎没有逻辑顺序。

core: 事件; 大事; 活动
meaning: n.事件; 大事; 活动.

exam.en: He attracted public attention at a media event.
exam.cn: 他在一次媒体活动上引起了公众的关注。

examples.en: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
examples.cn: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

core: 账户; 描述; 解释
meaning: n.账户; 描述; 解释. v.解释; 占(account for).

exam.en: They account for age differences in learning.
exam.cn: 它们解释了学习中的年龄差异。

examples.en: My salary is paid into my bank account.
examples.cn: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

examples.en: I’ve opened an account with Barclay’s Bank.
examples.cn: 我在巴克莱银行开了一个账户。

core: 交易; 大量(a great deal); 待遇
meaning: n.交易; 大量(a great deal); 待遇. v.处理; 分给.

exam.en: It is suffering a great deal from the incident.
exam.cn: 它因这次事件遭受了巨大的损失。

examples.en: Whose turn is it to deal?
examples.cn: 轮到谁发牌了?

examples.en: How could I deal with them before?
examples.cn: 我以前是怎样处理它们的?。

meaning: n.程度; 学位; 度.

exam.en: They enjoy doing engineering to the best degree.
exam.cn: 他们喜欢把工程做到极致。

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
examples.cn: 把烘箱预热至425度。

core: 头脑; 智力; 思想
meaning: n.头脑; 智力; 思想. v.介意; 注意.

examples.en: The Internet, to my mind, represents information exchange at its best.
examples.cn: 因特网在我看来是最好的信息交换方式。

examples.en: I don’t mind the heat, in fact I quite like it.
examples.cn: 我不介意这么热,事实上我还挺喜欢的。

core: 上升; 增加; 增长
meaning: n.上升; 增加; 增长. vi.升起; 增加; 起床.

exam.en: It can give rise to gender bias.
exam.cn: 它会引起性别偏见。

examples.en: The police seem unable to cope with the rising tide of (= large increase in ) car crime.
examples.cn: 面对日益增多的汽车罪案,警方似乎无能为力。

examples.en: She watched the steady rise and fall of his chest.
examples.cn: 她看着他的胸膛均匀地一起一伏。

meaning: v. 证明；结果是

examples.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
examples.cn: 你错了,我可以证明。

examples.en: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
examples.cn: 为了证明自己的观点,他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

meaning: v. 交往 adj. 副的 n. 伙伴,同事

examples.en: I don’t like these layabouts you’re associating with.
examples.cn: 我不喜欢你结交的这些游手好闲的人。

examples.en: Through science we've got the idea of associating progress with the future.
examples.cn: 通过科学我们已有了将进步与未来联系起来的观念。

core: 消息; 信息; 要旨
meaning: n.消息; 信息; 要旨.

exam.en: They sent out a message to calm them down.
exam.cn: 他们发出了一条消息让他们冷静下来。

examples.en: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
examples.cn: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

examples.en: I got a message you were trying to reach me.
examples.cn: 我得到了一条留言,说你在设法联系我。

core: 发展; 发育; 进展
meaning: n.发展; 发育; 进展.

exam.en: The speed of their brain development in infancy.
exam.cn: 他们在婴儿期大脑发育的速度。

examples.en: child development
examples.cn: 儿童发育

meaning: adv.以后; 后来. adj.较晚的; 后来的(late 的比较级).

exam.en: It will become the norm sooner or later.
exam.cn: 它迟早会成为常态。

examples.en: I’m going out for a bit – I’ll see you later.
examples.cn: 我出去一会儿——回头见。

core: 维持; 保持; 维修; 赡养
meaning: vt.维持; 保持; 维修; 赡养.

exam.en: Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control?
exam.cn: 为什么我们保持自控会很难？

examples.en: Careers Officers maintain contact with young people when they have left school.
examples.cn: 年轻人离开学校以后,职业指导员和他们保持联系。

examples.en: Britain wants to maintain its position as a world power.
examples.cn: 英国想保持其世界强国的地位。

meaning: prep.在……之内; 不超过.

exam.en: Make a decision within a few days.
exam.cn: 在几天之内做出决定。

examples.en: We should have the test results back within 24 hours.
examples.cn: 我们24小时之内应该可以拿到化验结果。

examples.en: He fell sick and died within a matter of weeks.
examples.cn: 他病倒了,不出几星期就死了。

meaning: adv./pron.也(不); (两者中)任何一个.

exam.en: But most Los Angeles residents are no longer either shocked or ashamed.
exam.cn: 但大多数洛杉矶居民不再感到震惊或羞耻。

examples.en: There’s tea or coffee – you can have either.
examples.cn: 有茶和咖啡,你可任选一种。

examples.en: We can offer a comfortable home to a young person of either sex.
examples.cn: 我们可以为年轻的男性或女性提供舒适的住处。

core: 各种各样的; 不同的
meaning: adj.各种各样的; 不同的.

meanings.cn: 各种各样的, 不同的

exam.en: It is witnessing various types of innovations.
exam.cn: 它正见证着各种类型的创新。

examples.en: The jacket is available in various colours.
examples.cn: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

examples.en: There are various ways to answer your question.
examples.cn: 有多种方法可以回答你的问题。

meaning: adj.主要的; 最重要的.

exam.en: Ensure people don't miss their main meals.
exam.cn: 确保人们不错过他们的主餐。

examples.en: The heater will run off mains gas or bottled gas.
examples.cn: 热水器使用管道煤气或罐装煤气均可。

examples.en: The main reason for living in Spain is the weather.
examples.cn: 居住在西班牙的主要原因是天气。

meaning: n.雇员; 员工.

exam.en: It does much harm to employee loyalty.
exam.cn: 这对员工的忠诚度伤害很大。

examples.en: a government employee
examples.cn: 政府雇员

core: 班级; 课; 阶级; 种类
meaning: n.班级; 课; 阶级; 种类.

exam.en: To review what is learned in class.
exam.cn: 复习课堂上学过的内容。

examples.en: He had to spend about six months in a class with younger students.
examples.cn: 他不得不在一个比他小的学生的班上呆了大约六个月。

examples.en: He’s not in the same class (= not as good ) as her at tennis.
examples.cn: 他的网球水平并不如她。

meaning: n.行为; 举止.

meanings.cn: 行为, 举止, 表现

exam.en: It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.
exam.cn: 它是指导人们行为的一项道德准则。

meaning: n.疾病; 弊病.

exam.en: Addiction to computer games is a disease.
exam.cn: 沉迷于电脑游戏是一种疾病。

examples.en: His father died of heart disease.
examples.cn: 他父亲死于心脏病。

examples.en: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.cn: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

meaning: n. 工人

examples.en: the workers’ revolution
examples.cn: 工人阶级革命

meaning: n.&v.控制; 管理; 克制.

exam.en: They found it easy to control their emotions.
exam.cn: 他们发现控制自己的情绪很容易。

examples.en: The disease robs you of muscle control.
examples.cn: 这种疾病会让你丧失肌肉控制力。

examples.en: ‘Do you need any help?’ ‘No. It’s under control , thanks.’
examples.cn: “你需要帮忙吗?”“不用,已经搞定了。谢谢。”

core: 产品; 产物; 结果
meaning: n.产品; 产物; 结果.

exam.en: Fall in love with boredom and focus your energy on the process, not the product.
exam.cn: 爱上无聊，将精力集中在过程而非结果上。

examples.en: The London factory assembles the finished product .
examples.cn: 伦敦工厂组装成品。

examples.en: He works in marketing and product development.
examples.cn: 他从事营销和产品开发。

core: 练习; 实践; 惯例
meaning: n.练习; 实践; 惯例. v.练习; 实践.

exam.en: He wanted to apply his Harvard training to practice.
exam.cn: 他想把在哈佛所受的训练应用于实践。

examples.en: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
examples.cn: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

examples.en: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
examples.cn: 稍微再练一练,你应该能通过考试了。

meaning: n.环境; 周围状况.

exam.en: Create an ideal study environment for them.
exam.cn: 为他们创造一个理想的学习环境。

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.cn: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.cn: 保护环境的法规

core: 系统; 体系; 制度
meaning: n.系统; 体系; 制度.

exam.en: Make a specific note on the company's system.
exam.cn: 在这家公司的系统上做特别标注。

examples.en: an alarm system
examples.cn: 警报系统

examples.en: a well-designed heating system
examples.cn: 设计良好的供暖系统

core: 自然的; 天然的; 天生的
meaning: adj.自然的; 天然的; 天生的.

exam.en: It has done a good job in combating natural disasters.
exam.cn: 它在抗击自然灾害方面做得很出色。

examples.en: the study of the natural world
examples.cn: 对自然界的研究

examples.en: an area of spectacular natural beauty
examples.cn: 自然风景秀丽的地区

core: 自由的; 免费的; 空闲的
meaning: adj.自由的; 免费的; 空闲的. v.使自由; 释放.

exam.en: A house with a lot of free space.
exam.cn: 一栋有很多空闲空间的房子。

examples.en: Admission is free for children under 9.
examples.cn: 九岁以下儿童免费入场。

examples.en: All students are offered free accommodation.
examples.cn: 所有学生都免费住宿。

meaning: adj.传统的; 惯例的.

exam.en: They hunted ducks as a traditional sport.
exam.cn: 他们猎鸭作为一种传统运动。

examples.en: traditional Italian cooking
examples.cn: 传统的意大利烹饪

examples.en: a traditional Irish folk song
examples.cn: 传统的爱尔兰民歌

meaning: n. 专家；行家 adj. 熟练的

examples.en: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
examples.cn: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

examples.en: ……a yoga expert.
examples.cn: ……一位瑜伽专家。

meaning: n.成员; 会员.

exam.en: It had a crew member fix the problem.
exam.cn: 它让一名机组人员解决了这个问题。

examples.en: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
examples.cn: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

core: 心脏; 内心; 核心
meaning: n.心脏; 内心; 核心.

exam.en: Red meat itself does not cause heart diseases.
exam.cn: 红肉本身并不会导致心脏病。

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

examples.en: Can you hear my heart beating?
examples.cn: 你能听见我的心跳吗?

core: 政策; 方针; 保险单
meaning: n.政策; 方针; 保险单.

exam.en: They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy.
exam.cn: 他们没有穿学校新政策要求的鞋子。

examples.en: an insurance policy
examples.cn: 保险单

examples.en: ……plans that include changes in foreign policy and economic reforms.
examples.cn: ……包括外交政策调整和经济改革的计划。

core: 工业; 行业; 产业
meaning: n.工业; 行业; 产业.

exam.en: And what it pays for is often a pro-industry finding.
exam.cn: 而它花钱买来的往往是一份对行业有利的发现。

examples.en: I work in the oil industry.
examples.cn: 我在石油行业工作。

examples.en: Italy’s thriving tourist industry
examples.cn: 意大利蓬勃发展的旅游业

core: 担心; 关切; 重要的事
meaning: n.担心; 关切; 重要的事. v.涉及; 使担忧.

exam.en: Where it is heard, the message is causing concern.
exam.cn: 在听到这个消息的地方，它正引起担忧。

examples.en: Issues like food additives do concern me.
examples.cn: 食品添加剂这类事情确实使我很担心。

examples.en: His main concern is to be able to provide for his family.
examples.cn: 他最为关心的事就是能够养家。

meaning: n.礼物; 现在. adj.在场的; 目前的. v.[prɪˈzent]颁发; 提出; 展现.

exam.en: He was asked to present a gold medal to Miu Goto.
exam.cn: 他被要求向后藤美羽颁发一枚金牌。

examples.en: She was presented with an award .
examples.cn: 她被授予一个奖项。

examples.en: the present situation of the millions of people who are suffering poverty and disease
examples.cn: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

core: 声称; 主张; 要求; 索取
meaning: v.声称; 主张; 要求; 索取. n.声称; 断言; 索赔.

meanings.cn: 要求, 认领, 索赔

exam.en: Ancestry tests claim to reveal our genetic identities.
exam.cn: 血统测试声称能揭示我们的基因身份。

examples.en: I don’t claim to be a feminist, but I’d like to see more women in top jobs.
examples.cn: 我不会自称是女权主义者,但我希望看到更多的女性担任高职。

examples.en: Opposition leaders will claim victory if the turnout is lower than 50%.
examples.cn: 如果投票率低于 50%,反对党领袖将宣布获胜。

meaning: n.一半; 半场. adj.一半的. adv.一半地.

exam.en: By investing half of one's monthly income.
exam.cn: 通过将自己月收入的一半用于投资。

examples.en: Only half the guests had arrived by seven o’clock.
examples.cn: 7点钟前只来了一半客人。

examples.en: If you look at our members, at least half are women.
examples.cn: 看看我们的会员,至少有一半是女性。

meaning: adj.成功的; 有成就的.

exam.en: My father is a successful senior executive.
exam.cn: 我的父亲是一位成功的高级管理人员。

examples.en: The operation was successful.
examples.cn: 手术成功了。

examples.en: a highly successful (= very successful ) meeting
examples.cn: 十分成功的会议

core: 通道; 进入权; 使用机会
meaning: n.通道; 进入权; 使用机会. v.访问; 存取.

exam.en: Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods.
exam.cn: 使他们能够更多地获得营养食品。

examples.en: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
examples.cn: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

examples.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
examples.cn: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

core: 积极的; 肯定的; 正面的
meaning: adj.积极的; 肯定的; 正面的.

exam.en: They have more positive qualities than most of us.
exam.cn: 他们比我们大多数人拥有更多积极品质。

examples.en: At least something positive has come out of the situation.
examples.cn: 至少这个情况也产生了一些积极的东西。

examples.en: Write down all the positive things about your life.
examples.cn: 记下生活中所有好的事情。

meaning: adj.经济的; 经济学的.

exam.en: It may soon replace the traditional economic model.
exam.cn: 它可能很快就会取代传统的经济模式。

examples.en: Economic growth is slow.
examples.cn: 经济增长缓慢。

examples.en: the government’s economic policy
examples.cn: 政府的经济政策

core: 链环,环节；联系,关系；连接,连结
meaning: n. 链环,环节；联系,关系 v. 连接,连结

examples.en: Send an email to the above address to report a broken link (= a link that is not working properly ).
examples.cn: 如发现链接失败,请发送电子邮件至上述地址告知。

examples.en: He walked with her, linking arms (= putting his arm around her arm ).
examples.cn: 他与她挽臂同行。

core: 生产; 制造; 产生
meaning: v.生产; 制造; 产生. n.农产品(尤指蔬果).

exam.en: To check the prices of his farm produce.
exam.cn: 检查他的农产品的价格。

examples.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
examples.cn: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

examples.en: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
examples.cn: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

meaning: v. 教 n. (Teach)人名

examples.en: She taught me fractions and counting.
examples.cn: 他教我分数和计算。

meaning: adj.值…钱的; 值得…的. n.价值.

exam.en: It's worth asking if things are necessary.
exam.cn: 问问事情是否必要是值得的。

examples.en: You should not deprecate your own worth.
examples.cn: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

examples.en: The worth of our lives comes, not in what we do or who we know, but by WHO WE ARE.
examples.cn: 我们生活的价值不在于我们做了什么,或者我们认识谁,生活的价值在于我们是谁。

core: 共同的; 普通的; 常见的
meaning: adj.共同的; 普通的; 常见的.

exam.en: They will find they have something in common.
exam.cn: 他们会发现彼此有共同点。

examples.en: Heart disease is one of the commonest causes of death.
examples.cn: 心脏病是最常见的死因之一。

meaning: adj.每日的; 日常的. adv.每天. n.日报.

exam.en: It is ninety grams daily on average.
exam.cn: 平均每天是九十克。

examples.en: daily flights to Miami
examples.cn: 每日飞往迈阿密的航班

core: 决定; 确定; 判定
meaning: vt.决定; 确定; 判定.

exam.en: Others determine who wins and who loses.
exam.cn: 其他人决定谁赢谁输。

examples.en: Investigators are still trying to determine the cause of the fire.
examples.cn: 调查人员仍在设法弄清失火的原因。

examples.en: The amount of available water determines the number of houses that can be built.
examples.cn: 可用的水量决定可以建造多少房子。

core: 回答; 响应; 反应
meaning: n.回答; 响应; 反应.

exam.en: It was a response to the changing job market.
exam.cn: 这是对不断变化的就业市场的一种回应。

examples.en: His immediate response was one of disbelief.
examples.cn: 他的第一反应是不相信。

examples.en: Emmett’s new exhibition has met with a favourable response from critics.
examples.cn: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

core: 搜索; 搜寻; 搜查
meaning: v.搜索; 搜寻; 搜查. n.搜寻; 检查.

exam.en: Search for the meaning of their life.
exam.cn: 寻找他们生命的意义。

examples.en: It was too dark to search further.
examples.cn: 天太暗,无法继续寻找。

examples.en: The area was thoroughly searched .
examples.cn: 这一地区已被彻底搜查过。

core: 预期的; 应支付的; 由于(due to)
meaning: adj.预期的; 应支付的; 由于(due to).

exam.en: Due to a fire alarm in their apartments.
exam.cn: 由于他们公寓里响起了火警。

examples.en: Any money due you will be sent by cheque through the post.
examples.cn: 应该支付给你的款项将会以支票邮寄给你。

examples.en: The next income tax payment is due on 31 January.
examples.cn: 下一次的所得税支付期限是1月31日。

meaning: v. 尊敬；把…………看作 n. 注意

examples.en: My husband sends his regards .
examples.cn: 我丈夫向你问好。

examples.en: Hope to see you soon. Regards, Chris
examples.cn: 希望很快见到你。 祝安,克里斯

core: 真实的; 正确的; 忠实的
meaning: adj.真实的; 正确的; 忠实的.

exam.en: It is what proves valid and true to life.
exam.cn: 它是被证明有效且符合实际生活的东西。

examples.en: Everything I had heard about him was true.
examples.cn: 我所听到的关于他的一切都是真的。

examples.en: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
examples.cn: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

meaning: v. 取决于；依赖,依靠

examples.en: He depended on his writing for his income.
examples.cn: 他靠写作谋生。

meaning: adj.昂贵的.

exam.en: They are a bit expensive for her.
exam.cn: 对她来说它们有点贵。

examples.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
examples.cn: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
examples.cn: 汽油越来越贵了。

meaning: v. 解释；说明

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
examples.cn: 他仔细解释了程序。

meaning: v. 检查；调查

examples.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examples.cn: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examples.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
examples.cn: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

meaning: n.影响; 作用. v.影响; 左右.

exam.en: Phones influence all aspects of teenage life.
exam.cn: 手机影响着青少年生活的方方面面。

examples.en: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
examples.cn: 身为一名科学家,他的影响力极大。

examples.en: He used his influence to get his son into medical school.
examples.cn: 他利用权势把儿子弄进了医学院。

meaning: v. 争论；论证；主张；说服；争论,争辩,辩论 n. (Argue)人名

examples.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
examples.cn: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

meaning: v. 经过；传递 n. 及格

examples.en: You will need at least three passes to get onto the course.
examples.cn: 你至少需要三门及格才能上这门课。

examples.en: The pass mark (= the mark you need to be successful ) is 55%.
examples.cn: 及格分数是55分。

core: 严肃的; 严重的; 认真的
meaning: adj.严肃的; 严重的; 认真的.

exam.en: If serious reading dies, a lot will go with it.
exam.cn: 如果严肃阅读消亡，很多东西也会随之消失。

examples.en: the serious problem of unemployment
examples.cn: 严重的失业问题

examples.en: Luckily, the damage was not serious.
examples.cn: 还好,损坏不算严重。

meaning: prep.尽管; 不管.

exam.en: It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions.
exam.cn: 尽管出于好意，它仍可能导致误解。

examples.en: Liz realized that, despite herself, she cared about Edward.
examples.cn: 利兹发现自己不由自主地在乎爱德华。

examples.en: Despite all our efforts to save the school, the authorities decided to close it.
examples.cn: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校,当局还是决定把它关闭。

meaning: vt.表达; 表示. n.快车; 快递. adj.明确的; 快速的.

exam.en: You are now to write an essay to express your view.
exam.cn: 你现在要写一篇文章来表达你的观点。

examples.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
examples.cn: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.cn: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

meaning: n. 举止,行为；指导 v. 进行

examples.en: The Senator’s conduct is being investigated by the Ethics Committee.
examples.cn: 该参议员的行为正受到道德委员会的调查。

examples.en: an inquiry into the conduct of the police
examples.cn: 对警方行为的调查

core: 揭露, 泄露；展现, 显示
meaning: v. 揭露, 泄露；展现, 显示

examples.en: He may be prosecuted for revealing secrets about the security agency.
examples.cn: 他可能因泄露安全部门的机密而被起诉。

examples.en: a test that can reveal a teacher’s hidden skills
examples.cn: 能够展现老师潜在技能的测试

core: 强大的; 有力的; 有影响力的
meaning: adj.强大的; 有力的; 有影响力的.

exam.en: Their brain is more powerful than that of right-handed people.
exam.cn: 他们的大脑比右撇子人的大脑更强大。

examples.en: He was one of the most powerful men in Bohemia.
examples.cn: 他是波希米亚最有权势的人物之一。

examples.en: a very influential and powerful family
examples.cn: 很有权势的家庭

meaning: n. 推,决心；大规模攻势

examples.en: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
examples.cn: 它一动不动,因此她加力去推。

examples.en: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
examples.cn: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

meaning: n. 奇迹；惊奇 v. 想知道

examples.en: It’s a wonder no one got hurt.
examples.cn: 竟然没有人受伤,真是奇迹。

examples.en: Mickelson was hailed as the wonder boy of American golf.
examples.cn: 米克尔森被称颂为美国高尔夫球界的神奇男孩。

meaning: v.设计; 构思. n.设计; 图案; 构思.

exam.en: They are relatively uniform in color and design.
exam.cn: 它们在颜色和设计上相对统一。

examples.en: The tower was designed by Gilbert Scott.
examples.cn: 这座塔楼是吉尔伯特·斯科特设计的。

core: 运动; 锻炼; 练习
meaning: n.运动; 锻炼; 练习. v.锻炼; 运用.

exam.en: It studied the effects of exercise on sleep.
exam.cn: 它研究了运动对睡眠的影响。

examples.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
examples.cn: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.cn: 由于在办公室工作,我很少运动。

core: 空间; 太空; 空地; 间隔
meaning: n.空间; 太空; 空地; 间隔. v.分隔; 留间隔.

exam.en: A house with a lot of free space.
exam.cn: 一栋有很多自由空间的房子。

examples.en: How much space is there on each disk?
examples.cn: 每张磁盘有多大容量?

examples.en: The hedge takes up too much space .
examples.cn: 这树篱占了太多的地方。

core: 职业; 生涯; 事业
meaning: n.职业; 生涯; 事业.

exam.en: It was a way to advance in their career.
exam.cn: 这是他们职业发展的一个途径。

examples.en: a teaching career
examples.cn: 教学事业

examples.en: He realized that his acting career was over.
examples.cn: 他意识到自己的演艺事业已走到了尽头。
